charts.title: Kepler-93 b: orbits around Kepler-93
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-93's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-93 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Holczer et al. 2016 (2016ApJS..225....9H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOLCZER_ET_AL__2016): P 4.72674002 d

charts.title: Kepler-93 b: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-93 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (55, 74, 75) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 137151335, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 12-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
